song.title: Papa's Got a Brand New Bag Part 1

guitar.evidence: Jimmy Nolen, James Brown's longtime guitarist, pioneered the funk "chicken scratch" rhythm style on Fender Telecaster/Stratocaster, well documented in funk guitar history.

tone.target: dry staccato funk rhythm with wah accents
tone.profile: dry staccato funk rhythm with wah accents
tone.summary: A tight, compressed signal chain using a Fender-style clean amp (US Deluxe) combined with compression, an OD boost for grit, and a Wah pedal to achieve the characteristic funk rhythm sound.

rig.name: The James Brown Band - Papa's Got a Brand New Bag Part 1 - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Tighten the percussive attack and eliminate unwanted noise from muted picking.
Provide consistent volume and smooth out the dynamic range for tight, percussive 16th-note comping.
Add light crunch and grit without introducing heavy distortion, maintaining the clean funk character.
blocks.gap: The Blues OD is used to simulate a slight breakup/grit rather than pure boost, fitting the 'light crunch' requirement.

alternatives.reason: A more general option for light grit.

blocks.purpose: Provide the essential wah sweeps and filter modulation required for funk rhythm accents.
Simulate the clean Fender-style amp required for a bright, articulate funk tone.
Provide a bright and focused cabinet sound that complements the clean US Deluxe amp model.
Tuck the low end slightly to maintain tightness and add high-end sparkle for articulation.
blocks.gap: A dedicated EQ is needed to fine-tune the frequency response, especially cutting mud while retaining bite.

blocks.purpose: Optional subtle thickening for depth, but kept off to avoid washing out the dry percussive attack.
blocks.gap: The Chorus is generally avoided in pure funk, but included as a minimal option if more body is desired without heavy reverb/delay.

blocks.purpose: Provide minimal ambient space without adding noticeable wash or tail, keeping the sound dry and punchy.
blocks.gap: The reverb must be kept extremely low to avoid contradicting the 'dry' requirement, but a touch of Room helps glue the tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better articulation in funk rhythm.

proposals.reason: Enhance the bright, articulate punch needed for tight funk rhythms.
